needed.scope: Large property/development projects, including Ha Long Xanh and material CIP; cover complete material project population
fields: Project legal/economic ownership and partner rights
Saleable units/areas or contract receipts and expected collection dates
Remaining construction, land/infrastructure, selling and tax cashflows by period
Book asset mapping, pledged assets and debt included in the project model
Dated appraised value or project discount assumptions with justification

needed.item: VIC cash, obligation and claim schedule
fields: Building-maintenance funds and overlap with restricted deposits
Guarantee/interest-support obligations and overlap with book provisions and forecast spending
NCI and preferred rights attributable to valuation changes, not just book carrying amounts

alternatives: A VIC-issued dated independent appraisal with scope/claims/debt/tax clearly stated can replace reconstruction of that project
A complete VIC RNAV/SOTP worksheet with source operands and no subsidiary/underlying duplication can be reviewed directly
notRequestedAgain: VIC annual FY2025 and Ha Long Xanh disclosure acquired in this run
note: No permission question or implied requirement to obtain private records. This is the specific missing economic information if the owner has an additional VIC document. Do not infer it exists publicly or ask to reconfirm source facts.
